content: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED is the standard Postgres single-owner/queue claim pattern: skip rows locked by other txns, LIMIT 1, composite index on (status, ...). Lock tied to txn so a worker crash auto-rolls-back and re-exposes the row. For jobs longer than one transaction, add a locked_at/lease column + a reaper for stuck jobs and make handlers idempotent. A conditional UPDATE ... WHERE owner IS NULL OR lock_expires_at < now() RETURNING is the claim-don't-check equivalent.
